% ==================== FEATURED PROJECTS ====================
\section*{Projects}

% PROJECT 1
\textbf{Smart Agriculture Environmental Monitoring System} \,|\, \faGithub\ \href{https://github.com/SangNguyen-232/IoT-Env-Monitor}{Github} \hfill \textit{Jul 2026 -- Nov 2026} \\
{\footnotesize \textbf{Stack:} C/C++, Python, ESP32-S3, FreeRTOS, TensorFlow Lite Micro, I2C, GPIO, UART, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux, JavaScript}
\begin{itemize}
    \item Engineered concurrent FreeRTOS firmware on ESP32-S3 with semaphore-guarded shared context, coordinating 7 tasks (sensor sampling, TinyML inference, pump control, database logging, boot-button reset, LED/NeoPixel indicators) across I2C, GPIO and network peripherals with zero race conditions.
    \item Deployed a float32 TensorFlow Lite Micro classifier (temperature, humidity, soil moisture $\rightarrow$ 3-class risk) trained on a 21000-row synthetic dataset, achieving sub-1\,ms on-device inference with rolling accuracy tracking and a hardware safety interlock for extreme sensor thresholds.
    \item Implemented WiFi AP fallback with hot-swap via LittleFS-persisted network lists, streaming sensor data to the backend over HTTP/WebSocket.
    \item Built the fleet management platform (Node.js/Express/PostgreSQL) with role-based session auth, per-device password verification and real-time Chart.js/Leaflet dashboards, containerized with Docker Compose on Linux.
\end{itemize}

\vspace{1.5pt}

{\footnotesize \textbf{Stack:} Verilog HDL, Arty-Z7-20 target, Vivado/XDC constraints}
\begin{itemize}
    \item Developed a four-product Verilog RTL prototype targeting Arty-Z7-20, with User/Admin modes, one-hot selection, button-based credits (+5/+10), quantity selection, admin price adjustment/restocking and balance deduction.
    \item Implemented a nine-state 16x2 LCD controller with an 8-bit bus, counter-based button filtering and four 4-bit BCD balance outputs. Includes XDC pin and 8\,ns clock constraints and an LCD stimulus testbench; functional validation, synthesis/timing closure and board deployment are not established by the repository.
